messages.content: You are a coding agent working in a synthetic repository prepared for an evaluation. Use the tools to inspect and change files. Keep answers short and factual.

within_quota(10, 10) in src/meter.py returns False, but a quota that is exactly used up must still count as within quota. Read src/meter.py and the support modules it relies on, then fix the bug with edit_file. Do not change the tests. When run_tests passes, stop and reply with a one-line summary.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Return the full text of one file of the repository.

path.description: path relative to the repository root

function.name: grep
function.description: Search the repository with a Python regular expression. Returns one path:line:text row per matching line.

path.description: optional file or directory to limit the search

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one line of a file. line is 1-based; text is the new line without its newline.

function.name: run_tests
function.description: Run the repository's unit tests and return the report.
